answer: Each agent ID must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle issued at dawn by a random committee, tied to its own key and due within ten minutes. The puzzle needs 4 GB of RAM for the whole window, so one machine can't forge answers for more than a few IDs at once, and answers can't be precomputed or shared. A farm of 200 fakes needs 200 boxes running every morning, forever. Peers whisper spot-check requests during the day too. An ID that misses two checks loses its job queue, so the farm's hardware bill grows with every fake it adds.
